comment: How the MIRIX method sets up MIRIX for one cell. Only the fields listed here are sent; every other MIRIX setting keeps MIRIX's default. The cell fills in the rest: llm_config.model (the cell's model), model_endpoint (gateway role 'mirix'), context_window and max_output_tokens (config/models.json), embedding_config.embedding_endpoint (gateway role 'embedding'), embedding_model (protocol.EMBEDDING_MODEL) and api_key (the gateway's local credential, never a provider key). Each cell has its own MIRIX database, so the ids can be the same in every cell.
embedding_dim_note: gemini-embedding-001 returns 3,072 dimensions (its native size); MIRIX pads every vector to 4,096 itself (MAX_EMBEDDING_DIM).
retrieve_limit_note: MirixClient.retrieve_with_conversation's default limit (mirix/client/remote_client.py), which the method's retrieval call leaves unchanged.
flush_note: The method's finalize calls flush_skills() with its defaults; after_task has already closed every learning session.
